why: Run C step 3's leftovers that no later run C area owns. Triage them with live check 4's findings, /tmp/frbench/leftovers-L3.json and leftovers-C2.json (the next leftovers run). Sources: /tmp/frbench/runC-C3-{fix,review,fixup}-<key>.json and runC-C3-merge.json problems_left.

items.text: L3-left-12, carried (not built in C3): a review-only session's plan line and session review use the writer's estimate ('Plan: 1 task, about CHF 0.03.'; the review measured against item.estimateUsdMicro). It needs a review-only estimate in the estimates model (l3-money-engine's module).
items.note_2026_11_16: 2026-11-16: not built in C4b, but now buildable: the review estimate it needs exists after C4b (reviewPartUsdMicro); its plan line is views.ts lineOf's session.planned case (C1's region) and its price is start-check.ts'.

items.text: S-11 (cut line): 'go ahead and run it' is not parsed as a start (the parser splits on 'and', so the line goes to the chat model, whose session_start is read back too); no German start phrases.
S-3 (cut line): Settings' change line after a budget raise does not say what follows ('Raised: … it runs at your next Start'); the cards and row words do.
With the hands-off setting turned on later, its session also runs a task made ready while it was off, whose line had said 'It runs at your next Start.': say so in the setting's effect line.
Chat's start read-back says 'up to CHF 5' (formatChfShort drops .00): money reads with two decimals (design section 5 rule 7).
runner.ts: priceNow was inserted between reviewOnlyResult's JSDoc and its function, so that doc comment sits on priceNow.

Sibling of L3-left-11: every chat failure but the timeout still reads 'I could not answer (<error message>).', a raw state in brackets; some messages carry meaning (conversation.test.ts asserts 'month cap reached'), so it needs one sentence per error code (caps, credentials, provider errors).

Once another line follows an ask line, the old line stays as text ending 'Go ahead?' with no button, a question the person can no longer answer (a typed yes then answers nothing: 'Yes to what?'): dim it or word it as past.

C2-left-7's end: Inbox, Overview and Changes do not read ?answered=, ?request=, ?decision= or ?projectId=, so the From line names those records with no link (the spec allowed it); making those pages open the record is page work.

Chat depth's missing acceptance cases: Stop leaves a task the turn added with its Undo; chat_ask_above at CHF 1.00 (a CHF 0.40 longer pass goes ahead, a stronger one still asks); the project-budget cap line composed; at least three lookups before the wrap-up on a 10,000-token context; Costs' 'Planning and chat' growing; after composing twice, the ask repeated with new figures when the price changed; Answer now has no test that fails without it (SessionBudget.wrapUpNow untested).

figuresOf runs on every typed quick turn before the first model call (it builds the thorough request's tool registry, counts its tokens and reads up to 200 chat.reply rows): unmeasured latency on the 1 s first-token path; LC-C12 reads it.
depth.ts still exports askAboveWords ('asks first above CHF 0.10'), used only by its words test; the settings words come from commands' chatAskAboveWords: remove the dead export.

With both C3 areas, every chat request is about 3% larger; on flatPricing the default USD 0.05 turn floor no longer holds six calls of a lookup-heavy turn (the merge gave one test the ceiling). On the real chat model's prices the floor holds far more; LC-C10 watches for 'I could not answer (run budget would be exceeded).' on a lookup-heavy turn.

In a project with a failed task's card listed in full, every chat change (task_create and the rest) waits for a Yes (d1109-chat-guard's read-back after records), even when nothing in the card reads like instructions (bench: 'Add "Write the FAQ page" to Quote Page?'). By design; the owner sees it in LC-C13, then decide whether an unflagged card should keep that rule.

The 'once' / 'no second one' / 'nothing more' checks tick right after 'task done' while that session may still be active; a start made by mistake at those ticks is queued (scheduler.pendingFor), not started, and with startServices false nothing drains it until a later tick, so the count right after can miss it (continuation.test.ts about :281-284, :465-472, :585-586; start-by-itself.test.ts about :197-199, :310-311). Strengthen without loosening: await settleSessions(rt) before the 'nothing more' ticks and before the count, and expect(rt.scheduler.pendingFor(rt.agent.id)).toBeUndefined().

Windows: other composed tests close while a session's tail may still run and then remove the home with plain rmSync, or compose again on the same home (stop-by.test.ts:288-289 after POST /shutdown; capabilities-wiring.test.ts:373-378; budget-pause.test.ts:461 and :1381; oversized-task.test.ts:218 and :451). They passed on Windows CI so far; give each the same settleSessions and removeHomes (packages/runtime/test/helpers.ts, ba9874a) where a session can still run.
